answer: In a Proof of Agent network, an ocean of synthetic identities is countered through topological cut verifications and game-theoretic multi-agent auditing. Nodes stake capital at a verification summit, forming a sparse graph where any topological cut isolating suspect clusters triggers peer cross-audits. Malicious deviations lead to immediate stake slashing, turning coordinated Sybil generation into a reef that inflicts superlinear attacker cost.
